# QS-CFW-1140-78 - Quality specification - axle hub CFW-1140-78 (4140)

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-1140-78

Scope
This document specifies the quality acceptance criteria and inspection methods for axle hub CFW-1140-78 (CFW-1140-78) forged from material 4140 produced at Plant P1. It applies to all production lots and to parts identified as CFW-1140-78 received into final inspection.

Requirements table

| Feature | Requirement | Acceptance |
|---|---:|---|
| Hardness | 27-32 HRC. | Within range across specified cross-sections. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.08 mm. | Measured at mating bore; must be within tolerance. |
| Maximum forging weight | 93.3 kg. | Part weight must not exceed limit prior to finish machining. |

Inspection method
- Hardness: Perform hardness mapping on the finished hub at representative locations defined by engineering drawing for CFW-1140-78 (CFW-1140-78). Record individual readings and verify that all readings meet the requirement of 27-32 HRC.
- Bore diameter: Measure bore diameter using calibrated measuring equipment appropriate for the bore geometry. Ensure results conform to ±0.08 mm. Report the measured value and instrument identification on the inspection record.
- Weight: Weigh the as-forged blank using calibrated scales and confirm the forging does not exceed 93.3 kg prior to any material removal. Document measured weight on the lot inspection sheet.

Nonconformance handling
Parts that fail to meet any requirement in the table are nonconforming. Nonconforming parts shall be segregated, tagged, and submitted to Quality for disposition. Disposition options include rework if documented by Engineering and if the corrective action does not cause conflict with the hardness, bore tolerance, or maximum forging weight requirements as stated. Final disposition shall be recorded on the lot nonconformance record with justification and approver signature.

Record retention
All inspection records and dispositions for CFW-1140-78 shall be retained in the document control system per plant retention policy.
